description: Discover all URLs under a base URL by combining sitemap parsing with HTML link extraction from the seed page. By default discovery is scoped to the exact seed host (a leading 'www.' is treated as equivalent) and, when the URL includes a path, to URLs under that path; sibling subdomains and outbound links are excluded. Set include_subdomains=true to widen the scope to the whole registrable domain and probe common subdomains (docs, blog, help, support). The optional 'search' parameter filters the discovered URLs by case-insensitive substring match — it does NOT query a search engine. Runs synchronously and returns the discovered links immediately. Requires a Geonode API key, sent as the X-Api-Key header.

ignore_query_parameters.description: Strip query parameters when normalizing discovered URLs
ignore_query_parameters.title: Ignore Query Parameters

include_subdomains.description: When false (default), discovery is scoped to the exact seed host only. When true, the scope widens to the whole registrable domain: sibling subdomains found in the seed's sitemap/HTML are kept, and common subdomains (docs, blog, help, support) are actively probed for their own sitemaps.
include_subdomains.title: Include Subdomains

search.description: Case-insensitive substring filter applied to discovered URLs. Does not query a search engine; only narrows results found via sitemap/HTML discovery.
search.title: Search

url.description: Base URL to discover links from. By default discovery is scoped to this exact host (treating a leading 'www.' as equivalent) and, when the URL has a path, to URLs under that path. Set include_subdomains=true to widen the scope.
url.title: Url

name: map
title: Map a site's URLs
